segments.ja433:1.3: Sace tvaṃ yaññaṃ yājeyya, isiṃ lomasakassapaṃ.
segments.ja433:2.3: Na icche saha nindāya, evaṃ seyya [sayha (sī. syā. pī.)] vijānahi.
segments.ja433:4.3: Sāyeva jīvikā seyyo, yā cādhammena esanā.
segments.ja433:5.3: Aññaṃ ahiṃsayaṃ loke, api rajjena taṃ varaṃ.
segments.ja433:6.1: Balaṃ cando balaṃ suriyo, balaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā;
segments.ja433:7.3: Pitu atthā candavatī, vājapeyyaṃ [vācapeyyaṃ (pī. ka.)] ayājayi.
segments.ja433:8.3: Tassa mūlaṃ gavesissaṃ, checchaṃ rāgaṃ sabandhanaṃ.
segments.ja433:9.1: Dhiratthu kāme subahūpi loke, tapova seyyo kāmaguṇehi rāja;
segments.ja433:9.3: Tapo karissāmi pahāya kāme, taveva raṭṭhaṃ candavatī ca hotūti.
